**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm frustrated when I have to manually copy student IDs...")

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the user experience or button/panel you envision.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockup sketches, or screenshots of similar feature implementations here.
